name: quest-mod
description: Claude Quest: turns AI-assisted coding in Claude Code into an RPG with Quests, Encounters, XP and a HUD.

sageCallsPerQuest.title: Sage calls per Quest
sageCallsPerQuest.description: How many times the Sage may ask Haiku for a Question per ticket, for the session (starting a ticket again does not refill it). Over budget, Questions are skipped; 0 disables Questions during Quests. Sage XP is capped per Quest (200), so raising this adds Questions, not XP.

bossFightCallsPerQuest.title: Boss Fight calls per Quest
bossFightCallsPerQuest.description: How many Haiku calls the Boss Fight may make per ticket, for the session, beside the Sage's. 0 disables Boss Fight Questions: Quests close unfought.

sageCallsOutsideQuest.title: Sage calls outside a Quest
sageCallsOutsideQuest.description: How many times per session the Sage may ask Haiku for a Question while no Quest is active. 0 disables Questions between Quests.

hastyAnswerSeconds.title: Hasty answer (seconds)
hastyAnswerSeconds.description: A right answer quicker than this, from when the Question was shown, to a non-trivial Question is hasty: it earns a quarter of the XP.

nonTrivialLines.title: Non-trivial Question (lines)
nonTrivialLines.description: A Question pointing at this many source lines or more is non-trivial, so a hasty right answer to it earns reduced XP.

autoOpenScene.title: Open the Scene automatically
autoOpenScene.description: Open the Scene pane once per session when a surface that draws its art (the desktop, the editor) joins. Off, it opens only with /scene.

hudStyle.title: HUD style
hudStyle.description: pixel: on the desktop and in VS Code the HUD is a pixel-art strip. text: the text band, as in the terminal. The terminal always shows the text band.

soundVolume.title: Sound volume
soundVolume.description: How loud the Sound cues play, 0 to 100; 0 turns sound off. Sounds play on macOS (and wherever Claude Code has an audio player); a Linux or Windows terminal plays none. Sound never changes XP or the game.
